title: Keto Spanish Paella with Cherry Glaze
description: A keto twist on the classic Spanish dish, featuring a sweet and sticky cherry glaze. This recipe is perfect for a low-carb dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the Spanish sausage and cook until browned, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the chicken thighs and cook until browned, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the cauliflower rice and cook until lightly toasted, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the glace chicken broth and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to medium-low and cook, covered, for 10-12 minutes or until the liquid has been absorbed.
While the paella is cooking, mix the cherry jam with 1 tablespoon of water to thin it out.
Brush the cherry glaze over the paella during the last 2 minutes of cooking.
Remove from heat and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
